name: singlet_embedding_viz_hyperparameter_selection
title: Select embedding hyperparameters without visual inspection
description: Chooses t-SNE or UMAP settings for a fixed reference by scoring every candidate with label-free criteria: seed-averaged co-ranking QNX at K=30 with a stability tie-break (default), or the scDEED dubious-cell count. Writes the selected map, per-setting scores and the rule used. Each setting and seed is a full embedding, so call with dry_run first; use method rule_based for library defaults without a grid.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: grid_search scores settings by neighbourhood preservation; scdeed counts dubious cells; rule_based keeps library defaults.

embedding.description: Embedding algorithm whose hyperparameters are selected.

reference.description: Reference representation whose neighbourhoods are the ground truth.

key.description: obsm key of the reference, on the same cells as the map.

n_components.description: Leading reference components used as input.

grid.description: Candidate values; the search is their Cartesian product.

perplexity.description: Candidate t-SNE perplexities; each must be below the number of cells minus one.

learning_rate.description: Candidate t-SNE learning rates; empty uses openTSNE auto, cell number over exaggeration.

early_exaggeration.description: Candidate early exaggeration factors for t-SNE.

grid_search.description: Options for the co-ranking grid search.

selection_rule.description: Label-free rule; kl_fixed_perplexity needs exactly one perplexity.

n_seeds.description: Embedding seeds per setting for selection.

score_k.description: Neighbourhood size for QNX and LCMC.

score_subsample_n.description: Cells in the seeded scored sample.

scdeed.description: Options for the scDEED dubious-cell count.

similarity_percent.description: Fraction of cells used as neighbours in the similarity score.

dubious_cutoff.description: Null quantile below which a cell is flagged dubious.

trustworthy_cutoff.description: Null quantile above which a cell is trustworthy.

write_dubious_flags.description: Store per-cell dubious flags in obs.

multiscale_perplexities.description: Perplexities averaged in a multiscale affinity; empty uses one perplexity.

late_exaggeration.description: Exaggeration applied after the early phase; null disables it.

seed.description: Random seed for the scored sample and embedding runs.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory, device and embedding count without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obsm/hyper_tsne. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs with keys method, selection_rule, selected, selected_scores, default_scores, n_settings, n_embeddings, scored_scope. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device, n_embeddings, n_scored.
